description:
Specifies the border which will be displayed on all vertical table cell borders which are not on the outmost edge
of the parent table (all vertical borders which are not the leftmost or rightmost borders).

params.description: The vertical table cell border style.
params.name: sType

params.description: The width of the current border measured in eighths of a point.
params.name: nSize

params.description: The spacing offset in the vertical table cells of the table measured in points used to place this border.
params.name: nSpace

signature: SetTableBorderInsideV(sType: BorderType, nSize: pt_8, nSpace: pt, r: number, g: number, b: number): boolean
